summary: A lean, actor-driven battle beat with a clear emotional turn: tactical urgency gives way to a brief recognition of loss, which Shalabi suppresses to keep the unit moving. The dialogue is natural, playable and properly restrained.

lines.speaker: SHALABI

performance.delivery: Point hard toward the turning vehicle and drive the order across the gunfire. Keep the words clipped and exact; he is calculating, not panicking.

lines.text: اللِّي عَ الشِّمَالْ بِتْلِفّْ! اِضْرَبُوهَا قَبْلْ مَا تِطْلَعْ مِنْ الطَّرِيقْ!

performance.delivery: Call to Shalabi from close beside him, intending to acknowledge the silent pit or ask what to do. Let the unfinished address die when Mahmoud reads the captain’s face.
Say it without looking back, already pushing up to move. It is both an order to Mahmoud and a command to himself not to stop.
